notes.title: We just updated Pandea Stones
notes.content:
Good news - we just updated the game.

[b]What did we do:[/b]

[list]
[*] Added partial controller support
[*] Fixed German language, which wasn't showing the menu "How to play"
[*] Changed buttons, so you now have to jump with "x" and spin with "c". We did this because the french and german keyboards didn't have the "z" key button next to the "x".
[*] Fixed one small bug
[/list]

ENJOY THE GAME!
